light.best.quote: The panda plant prefers bright, indirect sunlight for at least 6 hours per day

temperature.minC.reason: 出典に傷む温度の記載はない。耐寒ゾーン9a（屋外で−6℃程度まで）とされるため、余裕をみて5℃とした

watering.growing.quote: The soil should be allowed to dry out between waterings.
